name: Tiny world models for autonomous robots/vehicles

mentions.name: Tiny world models for autonomous robots/vehicles
mentions.description: This project trains autonomous robots and vehicles using tiny world models under 50M parameters that train in 5–30 minutes on a single GPU, positioning itself against big models and bloated reinforcement learning.
mentions.problem: Big models and bloated RL are excessive for training autonomous robots/vehicles; the project instead uses tiny world models trainable in minutes on a single GPU.
mentions.source_excerpt: Declaring war on big models and bloated RL. Im training autonomous robots/vehicles by building tiny world models that are trained in 5-30 mins on a single GPU, with less than 50M params.
